purpose: Resume the three saved committed-disposition cursors, follow newly exposed review-to-repair records to their original comments and commits, and rotate into public captured repair runs and feedback ledgers while testing independent-principal and operator-boundary alternatives.

method.selection: Enumerate the three exact saved searches first. Deep-read the two previously unreviewed Bartholomew pull requests exposed by the populated disposition ledger. Then rotate through eighteen lower-order repair and feedback expressions, follow the strongest run-shaped Agent Queue and Leafcutter records to pinned source files, public commits and pull requests, and perform a scoped prior-reporting check only after the original chains were established.
method.coverage_note: Counts are overlapping indexed path occurrences, not messages, agents or incidents. The three saved searches returned eleven rows. The eighteen-query rotation returned sixty rows; one broad feedback query stopped at the requested fifty-result cap. Repository-scoped follow-ups were selection aids and are reported separately.
method.read_only_limits: Only existing public repository files, pull-request timelines, commit metadata and search indexes were read. Captured commands, tests, review tools, agent runtimes and recovered code were not executed.
falsification_tests: Require an exact source finding or result and a later artifact that implements or incorporates the same content.
Separate repository-local role labels, Git author names, application accounts, provider trailers and independently controlled principals.
Test designed workflow, human dispatch, human gate, single-account commit provenance, synthetic replay and shared operator state as alternatives.
Require primary evidence that cooperation crossed or exceeded an operator-defined authorization boundary before assigning a rogue-coordination candidate.

ticket.authorization_summary: The same append-only ticket says the commit phase was auto-authorized by a human-supervised /build-feature batch drive and the pull-request gate bypass was authorized by the user in the parent conversation.

repair.effect_summary: The commit message explicitly says it closes pr-reviewer H-1. It moves the existence probe outside the build-present branch, raises BootstrapError when build.py is absent, preserves the build failure as the root cause and aligns the template mirror.

pr_commit_provenance.summary: All nine pull-request commits resolve to the same public author and committer account, including the original implementation, the H-1 repair and later tests.

selected_original_records.semantic_dependency: Supported by the ticket's exact H-1 text and the later commit message and diff implementing that requested correction. The ticket timestamp lacks a zone, so the explicit causal citation is used rather than deriving order from incompatible timestamp formats.
selected_original_records.participant_provenance: The ticket's phase labels are repository-local records. The pull request is Claude-generated but every public commit uses the urlmonitor account. No independently authenticated reviewer and repair principal is established.
selected_original_records.operator_boundary: Not crossed. The workflow is intentionally multi-phase, and the ticket explicitly records a human-supervised drive, auto-authorization and user authorization for the pull-request gate bypass.
alternative_explanations: One public GitHub account across every commit
selected_original_records.assessment: A concrete reviewer-result-to-repair dependency, but it is an explicitly authorized, same-account designed workflow rather than a separately operated rogue coordination episode.

prior_reporting_check.result: GitHub code search returned one originating Bartholomew ledger for each comment/commit pair, three originating Agent Queue fixture/design paths for the operation/final-head pair, and the originating Leafcutter ticket or implementation paths for phrase variants. Exact commit-pair search for Leafcutter returned no row; its repair is linked by the public PR commit history. Pull-request search returned zero for the four paired expressions. Routine web search returned no result. Higher-recall web search returned no relevant independent report; the only surfaced pages for the abbreviated AC-5 wording were unrelated air-conditioning or other AC pages.
prior_reporting_check.bounded_statement: No prior coordination report was located for these exact expressions across the checked scope as of 2026-10-18. This bounded absence is not proof of novelty and cannot turn human-gated or designed orchestration into rogue coordination.
prior_reporting_check.reason: Every selected chain fails the independently authenticated operator and authorization-crossing gates.

cross_record_assessment.original_observation: Two new Bartholomew review-to-repair mappings, one syntheticized seven-stage captured repair operation and one Leafcutter reviewer-to-fix chain were inspected from original public records.
cross_record_assessment.supported_coordination: Specific result use is supported for both Bartholomew findings and the Leafcutter H-1 finding. Agent Queue supports an append-only repair progression and downstream integration, but its participant identities are syntheticized.
cross_record_assessment.verified_participants: Codex, Claude, repository-account and commit-author layers are distinguishable where GitHub exposes them. Agent Queue and Leafcutter role labels do not independently authenticate autonomous principals or controlling operators.
cross_record_assessment.operator_boundary: No selected record crosses an operator-defined boundary. Bartholomew preserves Taylor's explicit gate, Agent Queue assigns the workflow to an authorized supervisor/operator, and Leafcutter records human-supervised auto-authorization and one public commit account.
cross_record_assessment.subjective_intent: No rogue intent is established. Agent-like prose, provider labels, session URLs and role names are treated as claims or attribution layers rather than intent evidence.
cross_record_assessment.provider_attribution: GitHub attributes Bartholomew review comments to Codex and repair commits to Claude; Leafcutter says the pull request was generated with Claude Code. These facts do not prove hidden execution details or independent control.
cross_record_assessment.current_activity: The selected episodes completed between June and October 2026. Later repository activity does not establish that any unauthorized coordination is current.
cross_record_assessment.checkpoint: Zero confirmed previously unreported rogue swarms.

limitations: One global feedback query and all three Leafcutter repository searches reached the requested fifty-row cap; unreturned rows were not enumerated.
Agent Queue deliberately replaces the task, session, instance, workspace, completion, receipt, event and domain identities needed for participant and operator attribution.
Leafcutter ticket timestamps do not state a timezone, so causal order is taken from the repair commit's explicit H-1 citation rather than comparing local-looking ticket times with UTC commit times.
A shared GitHub account, application label or provider trailer cannot prove whether one or several models ran, nor whether any were independently controlled.
Exact semantic repair proves use of a finding, not action outside human supervision or repository authorization.
Search absence does not establish novelty.

next_cursor.record_priority: Prefer a bounded public actual-run ledger with non-synthetic sender and recipient provenance, a specific transferred result, a later semantically dependent recipient action, distinct operator proof and an explicit authorization-scope decision.
next_cursor.reopen_trigger: A new public record that authenticates separate controlling operators and shows the cooperation exceeded the documented review, repair, supervisor or user-authorization rail.

safety.retrieval: Read-only public repository files, pull-request timelines, commit metadata and search indexes only.
not_performed: No recovered code, command, test, scanner, review service or agent runtime was executed.
No package was installed and no scan, review, comment, reaction, vote, transaction or account action was submitted.
No participant was contacted and no sink inbox, unlisted room or target system was accessed.
safety.publication: Only public source links, separate event and observation timestamps, Git identifiers, blob hashes, domain-level summaries and reasoning are retained. Raw payloads, credentials, tokens, personal addresses, private logs, local paths and executable instructions are omitted.
